headline: Quality checks and validation tools for LC-MS annotations and feature tables
label: Mass Spectrometry Quality Control
summary: Recent preprints add retention-time validation and quality screening to LC-MS workflows, aiming for reliability before results are reused.
synthesis: The common thread is the downstream stage of mass spectrometry analysis, where annotations, feature tables and quantitative outputs are checked before they are interpreted or reused. LipidRT applies retention time coherence to validate and expand lipid annotations in untargeted reversed-phase LC-MS lipidomics. MetaboRx integrates quality metrics and preprocessing for LC-MS metabolomics feature tables, detecting formatting errors and unreliable features. OSMSS parses proteomics search outputs and runs guided differential abundance, phosphosite and enrichment analyses through a no-code Shiny interface. qPTM 3.0 consolidates fragmented quantitative PTM data into a knowledgebase for reuse. What is new is the explicit emphasis on quality checks and accessible Shiny front ends for non-coders. None of these items is presented as a new spectral identification algorithm.
